title: The Chemist Who Created a Compound That Freezes Instantly on Contact
hook: A single drop of this liquid turns anything it touches into a brittle ice statue in milliseconds.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visual of instant freezing is mesmerizing and terrifying, perfect for short-form video loops.

title: The Biologist Who Found a Bacterium That Lives Inside Volcanic Vents and Eats Metal
hook: Deep in the ocean, a creature that feeds on iron and survives temperatures that melt lead.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a 'metal-eating' organism feels like sci-fi horror, tapping into fear of the unknown deep sea.

title: The Physics Anomaly Where Particles Vibrate Faster the More You Cool Them
hook: At near absolute zero, some atoms start moving like they're on fire—breaking every law of thermodynamics.
why_this_can_go_viral: Contradicting basic physics rules triggers intense curiosity and 'how is this possible?' reactions.

title: The Scientific Fraud Who Faked a Study That Proved Plants Feel Pain and Scream
hook: A worldwide panic over vegan guilt—until it was revealed the entire study was a lie.
why_this_can_go_viral: Touches on a hot-button ethical debate, making people want to share to prove or disprove the claim.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Genetic Engineering Mistake Created a Self-Replicating Molecule
hook: They accidentally made a molecule that copies itself forever—and they can't stop it from spreading.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into the primal fear of unstoppable replication (gray goo scenario), a classic sci-fi horror made real.

title: The Chemist Who Accidentally Made a Polymer That Glows in the Dark Forever
hook: A broken beaker produced a material that never stops emitting light—and it's slowly poisoning everything it touches.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of 'forever glow' and 'toxic poison' creates a beautiful yet horrifying visual hook.

title: The Scientific Fraud Who Faked a Study Proving Humans Can Photosynthesize Like Plants
hook: Clad in green, they claimed we could live on sunlight—but it was all a hoax to sell supplements.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea is absurd yet believable enough to spark outrage and mockery, driving shares.

title: The Physics Anomaly Where Sound Waves Can Be Stopped Dead in Their Tracks
hook: They froze a sound wave inside a crystal—and when they let it go, it was exactly the same as before.
why_this_can_go_viral: The concept of 'stopping sound' is counterintuitive and visually abstract, perfect for thought-provoking content.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Scientist's Own DNA Contaminated an Entire Genome Project
hook: For years, half the data was just the researcher's own genes—and no one noticed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exposes the fragility of 'big data' science, making viewers question how much research is actually wrong.

title: The Neuroscientist Who Showed That Your Brain Can Forget a Trauma on Purpose
hook: A targeted injection can make you forget the worst day of your life—but the fear remains.
why_this_can_go_viral: Strikes a deep emotional chord—everyone has a memory they'd want erased, but the 'fear remains' twist is dark.
